slides.headline:
They kept the belt.
Now you order your coffee on it.
slides.subline: Anthracite Coffee Roasters, 10 Tojeong-ro 5-gil, Mapo-gu — a closed-down shoe factory reopened as a roastery, and still trading daily according to Seoul's official tourism listing

slides.label: The month-and-year Bakery News gives for Anthracite's opening — March 2010, inside a shuttered shoe factory in Hapjeong. Writing in January 2025, the trade paper described it as a roastery in its sixteenth year, still working out of that same building
slides.note: Sources: Visit Seoul, official Seoul tourism site (english.visitseoul.net) — address, phone, hours, prices, shoe factory · Bakery News, 23 January 2025 — March 2010 opening, founder Bang Hyun-ju, conveyor-belt counter · Sprudge, 24 April 2018

slides.title:
Three things the
factory handed over

items.d: Bakery News reports that the conveyor belt the factory once ran is now used as the counter the coffee is brewed on. Visit Seoul's listing says the owners kept many of the plant's industrial elements and added modern fittings around them

items.t: A shell of concrete and exposed steel
items.d: Sprudge, visiting in 2018, described concrete walls, stone floors and exposed beams — the room reads as a factory that was furnished rather than a cafe that was decorated

Visit Seoul notes you can order a coffee called Natsume Soseki or Pablo Neruda. Sprudge adds that the bags carry images of stark, angular pieces of coal; Bakery News says the founder studied music and philosophy in New York and names blends after bands, poets and philosophers

slides.title:
The name is a coal,
and so was the street.
slides.body:
Anthracite is hard coal. The cafe sits in Hapjeong, and Bakery News places it beside the Seoul Thermal Power Plant — the former Dangin-ri plant, which the Korea Herald describes as Korea's first-ever thermal power plant, originally built in 1930.

English Wikipedia records that a branch rail line to Danginri Station was completed in 1929 and carried passengers and anthracite coal. The plant has since been rebuilt underground and the ground above it turned into a park, Mapo Saebit Culture Forest.

No source we found has the company linking its name to the neighbourhood's coal, so treat that as a coincidence rather than a story. But the fuel that once arrived here by rail is now a word printed on the bags of a cafe built in a dead factory next door to it.
slides._note: the real message of this post

items.d: Postcode 04073, phone +82-2-336-7850, per the Visit Seoul listing. Nearest metro is Hapjeong on Lines 2 and 6
That is Visit Seoul's restaurant listing. A separate Visit Seoul editors' page gives 09:00-22:00, so the closing time is worth confirming before a late visit
Prices as published by Visit Seoul. The same listing names a Butter Fat Trio coffee and pastries baked on site — cakes, financiers, madeleines, cookies

items.t: There is more than one branch
items.d: Kinfolk counts six Anthracite locations, five in Seoul and one on Jeju. Hapjeong is the original. Sprudge reported public cuppings on Tuesday evenings in 2018, but that schedule is eight years old — check before turning up for one

slides.text:
This is research, not a personal review.
Every fact here comes from published sources, checked on 6 September 2026.
slides.by:
Two official listings disagree on the closing time, and the cupping schedule is from 2018.
A good building is a reason to walk in, not a promise about the cup — taste stays personal.

caption:
They kept the belt. Now you order your coffee on it.

Anthracite Coffee, 10 Tojeong-ro 5-gil, Mapo — a closed shoe factory. Bakery News dates the opening to March 2010; Seoul's tourism site lists it open daily.

Listings disagree on closing time; taste is personal.

Sources in the last slide. Save it for your trip.
